security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL and all external command findings were adjudicated as false positives. The URL is JSON Schema metadata, and the SKILL.md backticks are Markdown formatting rather than executable shell or Ruby code. A low privacy disclosure issue remains because the skill instructs use of public external research services.

remediation.suggestion: Add a short privacy note telling users that search topics and metadata may be sent to public research services.

content.user_title: Track IT News for Doctoral Research
content.value_statement: Researchers need current IT topics with credible academic backing. This skill links recent news to papers, venues, metrics, authors, and doctoral research questions.
actual_capabilities: Finds recent IT news for a topic and selected date window.
Links news items to papers through DOI, OpenAlex, Crossref, and specialized sources.
Summarizes venue metrics, publication status, dates, abstracts, impacts, authors, and credits.
Produces Spanish or English outputs in text, JSON, or both formats.
Marks unverified metadata clearly instead of inventing missing values.
limitations: Results depend on public sources and web or API availability.
Paid metrics like JCR or Scopus require separate user access.
Author metrics can be ambiguous when names or affiliations match poorly.
News without linked research may be marked as news only.

use_cases.title: Plan a Dissertation Topic Scan
use_cases.description: Survey recent IT news and rank which items have strong scientific support.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Research Seminar Brief
use_cases.description: Turn current technology stories into a concise evidence brief with venue and author context.

use_cases.title: Monitor Emerging Technology Risks
use_cases.description: Track news about AI, cybersecurity, data systems, or health IT with verified academic sources.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple topic and a short time window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Topic: artificial intelligence in cybersecurity. Time window: last 90 days. Depth: brief. Region: global. Output language: English.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Regional Signals
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a topic across a specific region and request both output formats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Topic: digital health records and privacy. Time window: last 6 months. Depth: medium. Region: LATAM. Output format: both.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Literature Watch Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a recurring research watch with venue metrics and author details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Topic: green cloud computing. Time window: last year. Depth: medium. Include venue quartiles, author h-index values, and confidence notes.

prompt_templates.title: Rank Doctoral Opportunities
prompt_templates.scenario: Prioritize research gaps for advanced doctoral planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Topic: secure federated learning for hospitals. Depth: deep. Rank findings by novelty, rigor, venue quality, and doctoral relevance.

output_examples.input: Topic: generative AI in software testing. Depth: brief. Output: text.
output_examples.output: A ranked brief with recent news, linked papers, venue notes, simplified abstracts, impacts, and suggested doctoral questions.

output_examples.input: Topic: zero trust architecture in universities. Region: global. Output: both.
output_examples.output: A plain-language report followed by a structured version that records metadata, confidence levels, and source URLs.

output_examples.input: Topic: AI for medical imaging privacy. Depth: medium. Output language: Spanish.
output_examples.output: Una síntesis en español con noticias, publicaciones vinculadas, métricas de revistas, autores, sesgos y vacíos de investigación.

best_practices: Use a narrow topic and a clear time window for better matching.
Ask for confidence notes when results will support academic decisions.
Review unverified fields before citing the output in formal work.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent DOI, quartile, h-index, or publication dates.
Do not treat news-only items as peer-reviewed scientific evidence.
Do not rely on paid metric fields unless you provide access or confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill replace a literature review?
faq.answer: No. It supports early discovery and monitoring, but a full review still needs manual screening and citation checks.

faq.question: Which sources does it prioritize?
faq.answer: It prioritizes OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, preprint servers, PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, and SCImago checks.

faq.question: Can it work without paid databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It defaults to free sources and asks users to mark premium metrics as unavailable when they cannot verify them.

faq.question: Can it produce Spanish output?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Spanish and English output through the idioma_salida parameter.

faq.question: How does it handle missing metadata?
faq.answer: It should use null values or explicit notes instead of inventing missing dates, metrics, authors, or identifiers.

faq.question: Is the output ready for citation?
faq.answer: It provides source links and metadata for review, but users should verify every citation before publication.
